lead_raw_text:
The structure of Pr2Fe4Bi4 (Pr(FeBi)2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 38), with 10 atoms in the unit cell across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers with 12 geometric neighbors (4 Bi and 8 Pr), Bi centers with 10 neighbors (4 Fe and 6 Pr), and Pr centers with 16 neighbors (8 Bi and 8 Fe). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner, edge, and face sharing between Fe and Pr 12- and 16-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing among Bi 10-vertex polyhedra.
